scope.summary: The selected scope is resolved. The old target can supply XML_PARSE_NO_XXE, but it always clears XML_PARSE_DTDVALID, making the documented combination unreachable.

assessments.reason: XML_PARSE_NO_XXE has a distinct option bit. The input can set it, and the target mask preserves it.
The option setter accepts XML_PARSE_NO_XXE in its option mask, and the pull route forwards the decoded options to it through xmlCtxtReadMemory.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The pull API applies the options before parsing.

assessments.reason: The documented DTDVALID plus NO_XXE mode is within the XML parser operation, but the target clears DTDVALID before every parser route.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The option setter enables validation only when DTDVALID is present.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The push and reader routes receive the same masked options.

build.reason: The supplied recipe builds and links the xml target against the library, and the referenced option names are declared in the supplied source. This is a static compatibility assessment, not a claimed build execution.

evidence.dependency_reason: The target's parser option constants are declared.

input.reason: Four input bytes supply the options, and subsequent encoded strings can supply a main XML document and URL.

evidence.dependency_reason: The helper decodes up to four bytes for the option value.
The first encoded entity supplies the main document and URL.

lifecycle.reason: The target keeps the document buffer until parsing finishes, frees the document and parser context, and cleans up fuzz data afterward.

evidence.dependency_reason: Fuzz data cleanup follows parser use.
The pull parser uses the supplied buffer during the call.

control_flow.reason: The shared option mask clears DTDVALID before the pull, push, and reader routes, so the documented validation mode cannot be selected.

evidence.dependency_reason: The other parser routes also receive the masked value.
Validation state depends on the removed DTDVALID bit.

blockers.requirement: The XML parser target must be able to request DTD validation together with XML_PARSE_NO_XXE, which disables external DTD and entity loading.
blockers.target_route: Supply XML_PARSE_DTDVALID | XML_PARSE_NO_XXE in the first four bytes, followed by an encoded main XML entity containing an internal DTD and a SystemID. The pull route passes its decoded options to xmlCtxtReadMemory.
blockers.failure_condition: The target unconditionally clears XML_PARSE_DTDVALID, so no input requests validation on that route.
blockers.alternative_paths: The complete target passes the same masked options to pull parsing, push option setup, and reader creation, and makes no separate validation request. DTDLOAD and NOENT do not set the validation bit.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: DTDVALID and NO_XXE have distinct option bits.
The setter derives validation state from DTDVALID.
The pull API applies the supplied options before parsing.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: Push and reader use the same masked options.
A finite encoded input can supply the main XML entity and URL.
